1 · Intro

When to use it.

Non-exempt pay depends on approved time cards. This course shows how to find your employees, check their status, and act on a time card.

In UKG the order is: the employee approves, the manager approves, then payroll signs off before payroll runs.

Use this whenYou are checking or approving non-exempt hours for a pay period.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in UKG. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Empty time cards early in an open period are normal.
  • In an open period, Save. Don't Submit. Submitting means you must edit, update, and resubmit later.
  • Once payroll signs off a time card, an approval can't be removed unless the sign-off is removed first.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • UKG: Timecard approvals for managers (opens in a new tab)
  • UKG: Work with pay codes in the hourly timecard (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

Review and approve time cards

Use when: You are checking or approving non-exempt hours for a pay period. · System: UKG (Kronos)

  1. Open UKG.
  2. Select By pay period.
  3. Filter to your department name.
  4. Review your non-exempt employees and their approval status.
  5. To see the open period, toggle the date range to the current period.
  6. Select an employee to act on their time card.
    • Submit the time card on their behalf.
    • Approve it.
    • Reject it, so it goes back for correction.
  7. To enter hours for them, open the time card, enter the time, and click Save.

Watch-outs

  • Empty time cards early in an open period are normal.
  • In an open period, Save. Don't Submit. Submitting means you must edit, update, and resubmit later.
  • Once payroll signs off a time card, an approval can't be removed unless the sign-off is removed first.
